items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: And they had a band around there that was called Earl Hood's band, Hooks, trumpet player, John Hooks. He was from Columbus.

ctx.x: get a band in every place that he would go to, he'd travel by himself, just barnstorm, . . just tell them, "Who can play? "Who are these cats in town who are musicians that can play, just tell them to come on, you know," get four or five of them, "we're playing a dance tonight." Man, gee--my nerves I never heard anything like it.

And they had some pretty good musicians in Columbus. Had a trombone player there, his name was Archie -- oh, he played with Jim Europe's band years ago.* Fantastic trombone player. And they had a band around there that was called Earl Hood's band, Hooks, trumpet player, John Hooks. He was from Columbus. Sy Oliver was from around there at the time.
John Hooks, didn't he go to Boston?
